review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–108) and its only downstream user, Estimates/PreparedEnlargedModularAllocation.lean. The file has no @[simp] attributes, no simp sets and no rewrite rules. Its three embedding defs are only ever used as opaque arguments: they are passed to allocatedTaggedRank* and wrapped in preparedInitial* with le_rfl. The only place their values are unfolded is the three *_reserved lemmas, which use `change … ; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _`. I considered proposing @[simp] `_apply` lemmas for these embeddings, but nothing outside those one-line proofs rewrites their values, so I would only be recommending a simp lemma because the identity looks simple, which the rubric excludes. The theorems *_card, *_disjoint and *_mem are fully applied forwarding lemmas whose bodies delegate to allocatedTaggedRank*; they would not make good simp lemmas, and I found no competing rule, unwanted expansion or cycle. I did not inspect the allocatedTaggedRank* lemmas in the imported file. Remaining uncertainty is limited to whether future uses will need `_apply` lemmas.
